intro: Disguised by Dartol's Rod of Transformation, adventurers gain the trust of Krolg, an uncorrupted furbolg near Lake Mystral. Disillusioned with both the arrogant night elves and the corruption rotting his own kin, Krolg asks for the death of the depraved chieftain Ran Bloodtooth so that the furbolgs can police their own.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The night elves are as old as time, but their arrogance destroys their very world. And now it destroys our lives too. But that can no longer be controlled...
I blame the elves for much, but we are still responsible for our actions. Even beyond the corruption, we are capable of great evil.

Ran Bloodtooth is one such evil. Power hungry, lusting... The corruption has only made him stronger. My hatred for the elves burns, but I do not wish ill upon their children, so we must police our own.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you slain Ran yet, my friend?
Even the Night elves do not truly deserve his wrath. His hatred burns even brighter than my own, but his mind is no longer his own. He is a threat to all the natural creatures of this forest.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, my friend.
The forest is still tainted, but at least we know we have done a small part to return it to its former glory. If you wish to return to me again, I would enjoy the company of my own kind.
Be well. Perhaps our tribes will meet again under less violent times.
